# Kalolary 5-Piece Acrylic UV Gel Nail Art Brush Set

## Dual-Ended Tools for Detailed Nail Designs
Create intricate looks with this 5-piece nail art set. Each dual-ended tool pairs a fine nail art brush with a dotting pen, so you can switch from sharp lines to tiny dots without changing tools. Use them to paint 3D patterns, plaid, florals, and gradient French nails with UV gel and glitter powder.

## Fine Tips for Precise Strokes
The thin brush hairs gather neatly, giving you control over every line. The lightweight, 15 cm design sits comfortably in your hand, so you can work with steady, accurate strokes on each nail.

## Ready for Salon Work and Travel
Whether you run a salon or practice at home, this set fits your routine. Its light weight makes it easy to pack for mobile manicures or trips, and the refillable design keeps your kit ready for the next appointment. Choose from pink, red, yellow, green, and blue to mix and match your palette.

## Quick Cleanup Between Designs
Wipe away glitter and gel with alcohol or acetone, and the bristles rinse clean with little effort. Spend less time cleaning and more time creating.

## A Thoughtful Gift for Nail Enthusiasts
Choose this set for beginners learning nail art, professional technicians, or the creative women in your life. Rated 4.5 stars by 860 shoppers, it's a practical addition to any nail art collection. Add it to your cart today and start designing.
